einvoice.title: E-invoice (IRN and QR)
einvoice.notPosted: The IRN is asked for once the document is posted.
einvoice.notRequired: E-invoice not needed for this document
einvoice.mockWarning: TEST IRN from the mock provider — not valid for GST
einvoice.pendingNote: E-invoicing is on for this GSTIN. Until the IRN arrives this invoice cannot be printed or sent, and the goods cannot leave.
einvoice.cancelledNote: The IRN was cancelled. Cancel this invoice or issue a credit note; a new IRN is not issued for the same number.
einvoice.cancelWindowNote: An IRN can be cancelled only within 24 hours of acknowledgement; after that, issue a credit note.

einvoice.irn_required: This invoice needs its IRN first (e-invoicing is on for the GSTIN). Get the IRN, then print or send.
einvoice.switch_off: E-invoicing is off for this GSTIN. Admin switches it on after the CA confirms.
einvoice.not_eligible: E-invoicing does not apply to this document (only B2B tax invoices and credit notes with GST).
einvoice.already_issued: This document already has its IRN.
einvoice.no_irn: This document has no active IRN.
einvoice.cancel_window: The IRN is more than 24 hours old and can no longer be cancelled. Issue a credit note instead.
einvoice.cancel_reason: Choose why the IRN is cancelled.
einvoice.cancel_irn_first: Cancel the IRN first (within 24 hours) or issue a credit note.

integrations.provider_not_set: No e-invoice provider is chosen yet. The owner picks the GSP on Settings.
integrations.mock_not_allowed: The mock provider works only on the development database.
